detailed_description: Email Preview Text Generator creates short preheader and inbox preview ideas for campaigns, launches, newsletters, and announcements. It pairs a subject line with supporting copy based on campaign topic, audience, benefit, and tone, then shows character counts against a practical 35-90 character preview range.
usage_steps: Enter the subject line, campaign topic, audience, reader benefit, and tone.
Review the preheader options and character counts.
Copy one preview text option or copy the full numbered set.
Paste the final line into your own email platform and test it with the subject.
usage_examples: Draft preview text for a product launch email.
Create supporting preheaders for a newsletter subject line.
Compare benefit-first and curiosity-led preview text before A/B testing.

faqs.question: Is Email Preview Text Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool runs free in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my inputs?
faqs.answer: No. The preview text options are generated locally in your browser.

faqs.question: Does it send emails or change my email platform?
faqs.answer: No. It only creates preview text. Sending, preheader setup, and testing happen in your own email platform.

faqs.question: How long should email preview text be?
faqs.answer: Many inboxes show roughly 35-90 characters, so the tool displays character counts to help you choose a concise line.
